_readme: DOCUMENTATION — a human/agent-facing inventory of this project's own candidate chart use cases (detector estate, gate scoreboard, docs estate, tier pricing, bank blueprint), captured at the Phase-0 inventory dated below. No code reads this file back; it is a planning artifact for an agent choosing what to visualize next, not a live registry, and it is not kept in sync as the corpus it describes changes. Labelled 2026-08-23 (P8-084).
source_evidence: Phase-0 inventory 2026-08-08: detector registry (514 detectors), gates (docs/system/SYSTEM.json gates[]), docs estate (1,124 docs measured S185), J1-J10 journey scoreboard, tier pricing (GP-2 signed), bank blueprint B1-B9 (203 mermaid fences)
